tips.title: Pick up where a job left off
tips.body: Stopped a job halfway? Use From Line to resume at any line. ncSender replays the modal state (units, work offset, feed, spindle) up to that line so the machine is set up exactly as it would have been.

tips.title: Touch-friendly view for the shop tablet
tips.body: On a phone or tablet the layout switches to a touch view with bigger targets. Pinch to zoom the visualizer, two-finger drag to pan.

tips.title: Save the park spot with a double-tap
tips.body: Double-tap Park and it turns into Save. Tap once more to store the current position as the parking location. Hold Park for one second to drive there.
